title: KHR_character_expression Expression Entry Properties
description: One labeled expression driver and its response animation.

name.description: Nonempty descriptive name, unique among entries in the containing expressions array.
name.gltf_detailedDescription: This name MUST be unique among all entries in the top-level KHR_character_expression.expressions array. Consumers MUST compare names by Unicode code point, without case folding, trimming, or Unicode normalization. Applications MAY provide name-based lookup using this comparison; array indices remain the authoritative entry identities. Name uniqueness requires semantic validation beyond this schema.

animation.description: Index of the animation used as this entry's expression response curve.
animation.gltf_detailedDescription: This value MUST be a valid index into the top-level `animations` array. Every channel of that animation is subject to the expression evaluator's validity rules and contributes to the expression duration. A channel produces response records only when a derived expression extension on this entry lists it and the consumer supports that channel as defined by the expression response evaluator; every other channel is not animated by the expression.
